environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the container on port 8080. Security group allows inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection or filtering rules configured on the ALB. The container runs as non-root with a read-only root filesystem, and the /data volume is an EFS mount with read-write access. CloudWatch logging enabled for access logs only.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules (forward all to target group)
config.network: public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
